claims.text: Retrieval-augmented generation adds the ability to upload files just-in-time to chatbots.
Chatbots are trained on large quantities of public data.
Just-in-time file uploads fill gaps in chatbot knowledge bases beyond public training data, including private data and recent events.
Filling knowledge base gaps via retrieval-augmented generation reduces hallucinations in chatbots.

evidence.description: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) adds a simple but powerful feature to chatbots, the ability to upload files just-in-time.
Chatbots are trained on large quantities of public data.
The ability to upload files just-in-time makes it possible to fill in gaps in the knowledge base that go beyond the public training data such as private data and recent events.
The ability to upload files just-in-time makes it possible to reduce hallucinations by filling in gaps in the knowledge base.

methodologies.name: RAG Tutorial Implementations
methodologies.description: Demonstrates how to upload files and generate prompt responses using tools from OpenAI, LangChain, HuggingFace transformers, and VecML.

limitations.text: Standard chatbots rely on public training data, leaving gaps in knowledge regarding private data and recent events.
